footer.tagline: Reliote connects project owners in France with the best architects in Côte d'Ivoire.

hero.sub: Reliote connects clients in France with the most rigorous architects in Côte d'Ivoire. Verified profiles, structured introductions, framed collaboration — for the decisions that deserve care.

pillars.kicker: Five principles structuring every collaboration. None of them is optional.

p1.b: Each architect is admitted by application, portfolio and interview. Fewer than 1 in 6 candidates make it through.

p2.b: Diplomas, professional registration, references and delivered projects are checked before any profile goes live.

p3.b: Structured brief, scope of work, milestones and deliverables are written into the platform from the first exchange.

p4.b: Fees, timelines, scope and clauses are stated clearly — no cost is surfaced halfway through.

p5.b: A Reliote duo follows the engagement through handover. Mediation included, on-site or remote.

architects.kicker: A short index — every profile is admitted by hand. You speak directly to principals, never to a sales rep.

process.kicker: Four checkpoints. You always know where you are — and where you're going.

s1.verb: We listen, we write, we structure.
s1.b: You describe the project across eight questions. Our team turns it into a structured scope of work.

s2.verb: We shortlist, we compare, we argue.
s2.b: Up to three architects, picked on fit, availability and experience. Each shortlist is argued, never random.

s3.verb: We orchestrate, you decide, in full knowledge.
s3.b: Video interviews, method samples, client references. You compare on equal footing.

s4.verb: We protect, we hold milestones, until handover.
s4.b: Reliote-framed contract, shared milestones, sequenced payments. Continuous mediation through delivery.

client.titlePre: Accept the charter before revealing the architect's
client.intro: Reliote sells a reasoned match and a framed mission. To reveal this architect's identity, you acknowledge the commitments below. This charter is versioned and timestamped at acceptance.
client.consent: I have read the 7 articles of the charter and accept them in full. I authorize the reveal of this architect's identity on the platform.

articles.b: Reliote presents up to three architects matching your brief. Each proposal is selected on dossier, skills, availability and fit — and comes with a reasoned note explaining the choice.

For 18 months following the reveal of an architect's identity on the Reliote platform, you commit not to enter into any mission, study or service directly with this architect outside the Reliote framework.

If you engage an architect presented by Reliote, the mission is conducted via the platform: structured brief, framed contract, defined milestones, sequenced payments via Reliote, mediation included for the project's full duration.

The architect's personal contact details (direct phone, personal email) are not transmitted to you. All initial communication passes through Reliote channels — anonymized relay addresses and video rooms supervised by your duo.
You commit not to reproduce, share or publicly disseminate the architect's professional information (portfolio, background, photos, references) outside the direct context of your project.
Any proven circumvention during the engagement period triggers a fixed penalty of 12% of the mission amount in question (all taxes included), invoiced by Reliote to the breaching party.
This charter takes effect at acceptance and remains valid for 18 months following identity reveal, regardless of whether the presented project materializes.

architect.intro: Admission to the Reliote index requires explicit acceptance of the 7 commitments below. The charter is versioned, timestamped at your admission, and remains valid for the entire duration of your presence in the index.

articles.b: Reliote presents you with qualified clients who have submitted a structured brief reviewed by our team. Each introduction is traced and timestamped on the platform.
Any mission engaged with a client introduced by Reliote is conducted via the platform: signed brief, framed contract, shared milestones, payments sequenced via Reliote, mediation included.

For 18 months following the introduction of a client by Reliote, you commit not to enter into any mission directly with this client outside the Reliote framework — even if they contact you through another channel.
Your mission fees flow through Reliote, sequenced by signed milestones. Reliote retains a commission agreed at your admission, withheld at each milestone validation.
Your personal contact details (direct phone, personal email) are never transmitted to clients. All initial communication passes through Reliote relay addresses and supervised video rooms.

Any proven circumvention triggers (a) a fixed penalty of 12% of the mission amount in question, (b) your immediate and permanent exclusion from the Reliote index, (c) suspension of all in-progress payments on the platform.
This charter takes effect at your admission to the Reliote index and remains valid for the entire duration of your presence — it renews tacitly with each introduction.
